scope: CPU-only component validation for independent product rescale allocation in frequency-basis reconstruction.
checks: Legacy FFT and prepared FFT/auxiliary NTT remain byte-identical with the default drop.
Legacy and prepared reconstruction agree byte for byte with a nondefault product drop.
Nondefault reconstruction independently matches the plaintext series at every slot, including direct roots, sums, differences and the nonzero constant.
Seven-root signed degree-40 basis requires three root conjugations, reused across frequencies.
